title: With Claude i built a small turn-based cold war armored combat game!
author: No_Anything6548
selftext:
I have no one else to show this to, but with Claude, I was able to flesh out a game idea I'd had in my head for a while.

This is what i’m calling **Red Specture Battle For Germany**. It's a fast-paced turn-based armored warfare strategy game.  Most rounds last no longer than five minutes its super arcadey, and it features kill streaks like from  Call of Duty.  All maps are randomly generated, and in this video i'm playing the campaign mode, which is pretty much galactic conquest from star wars battlefront 2 but Germany.

  
I was just hoping to get some first impressions, like if it looks like slop or if its something people would play!
